name: Time-limited stock recovery
job: Find a permitted buyer whose verified consumption window precedes the seller's stock deadline.
steps: Confirm condition and sale deadline
Locate explicit nearby consumption or processing needs
Check available receiving capacity and safe handling
Obtain an agreed inspected collection
proof: Current requirement, usable stock, accepted quality, viable delivered economics and receiving time
metric: Seller-approved collections completed before the confirmed deadline

name: Recurring replenishment
job: Find a business whose documented consumption cycle matches repeat supply.
steps: Confirm supply capacity and pack units
Find businesses using this input in their actual workflow
Check the next procurement cycle and supplier access
Offer a buyer-approved small replenishment trial
proof: Authorized replenishment need, pack/unit compatibility, recurring volume and terms
metric: Buyer-confirmed repeat orders with accepted quantities

name: Specification and use-case fit
job: Find an explicitly compatible application before identifying its purchasing route.
steps: Resolve exact specification and intended use
Locate authorized requests or professional integrators for that application
Check compatibility against original documents
Request a permitted sample or inspection decision
proof: Application, model/specification, original compatibility evidence and authorized requirement
metric: Independently adjudicated compatible requests, including unknown and rejected cases

name: Dated purchase project
job: Tie the offer to a real authorized event, launch or onboarding deadline.
steps: Confirm what can be delivered and by when
Find explicit dated briefs or authorized event intermediaries
Check event status, quantities and purchase authority
Prepare a seller-reviewed proposal for the specific brief
proof: Original current brief, confirmed date, quantity, responsible purchaser and permission
metric: Accepted proposals for independently confirmed dated needs

name: Installed-asset replacement
job: Follow an authorized maintenance need to a compatible installed asset.
steps: Confirm exact part or service compatibility
Locate authorized service contractors or explicit repair requests
Check the actual asset code and failure or renewal
Offer an inspection-backed repair or replacement
proof: Owner-authorized asset details, exact fit, safe condition and approved work scope
metric: Approved compatible service jobs or replacement orders

name: Private project procurement
job: Find the private project stage at which the offered item is actually procured.
steps: Translate the offer into a usable project component
Locate current private project briefs and authorized contractors
Verify project stage, measurements and decision rights
Prepare a scoped project quotation
proof: Private project authority, approved scope, timing, specification and budget route
metric: Qualified private project opportunities reaching an authorized quotation

name: Unused capacity booking
job: Match a real time slot, asset capability and service location to a booked need.
steps: Confirm available slots and operating limits
Find explicit booking briefs or authorized production partners
Check dates, site access and compatible capacity
Obtain a reviewed reservation with clear cancellation terms
proof: Actual availability, buyer's requested dates, required capacity and authorized booking
metric: Confirmed paid or contract-backed bookings within declared capacity

name: Reseller and processor offtake
job: Use a suitable intermediary to absorb stock when direct end-buyer discovery is thin.
steps: Confirm disclosed condition, volume and minimum economics
Locate intermediaries with a published relevant buying programme
Check eligibility and whether they currently accept this stock
Present an inspection or sample through the approved channel
proof: Published buying route, current intake acceptance, stock suitability and actual terms
metric: Accepted inspected intake offers, separated from intermediary directory records

name: Controlled professional procurement
job: Route regulated or safety-sensitive offers through qualified private buyers and current requirements.
steps: Identify the applicable professional and product checks
Locate authorized private procurement or service routes
Verify current permissions, documentation and actual requirement
Proceed only through an approved qualified workflow
proof: Current official requirements, qualified parties, product documents and authorized procurement
metric: Eligible documented opportunities after professional review; excluded cases retained

name: Authorized workflow migration
job: Find a buyer with a defined operational change and permission to migrate its systems or data.
steps: State the exact workflow the offer improves
Locate explicit project briefs or authorized implementation partners
Confirm data rights, baseline and responsible owner
Run a scoped reversible migration pilot
proof: Buyer-approved project, authorized data, acceptance test and rollback ownership
metric: Buyer-approved pilot acceptance against a recorded baseline

name: Confirmed business expansion
job: Find the procurement created by an approved business opening or capacity increase.
steps: Identify the operational requirement the offer can fulfil
Locate original expansion briefs and relevant private contractors
Confirm the expansion is current, funded and at the buying stage
Offer a compatible phased supply or installation
proof: Original current expansion evidence plus buyer confirmation of timing and procurement
metric: Confirmed expansion requirements progressing to approved supply

name: Consented pooled demand
job: Aggregate compatible voluntary orders when one buyer cannot meet an economical minimum.
steps: Confirm minimum lot and separable allocation
Find an authorized private buying-group coordinator
Obtain each member's explicit commitment and compatible terms
Allocate one approved collection or delivery
proof: Independent member consent, compatible orders, coordinator authority and payment allocation
metric: Committed compatible group orders meeting the actual minimum without invented members

name: Verified seasonal buying window
job: Align stock with a verified calendar or production cycle rather than assumed seasonal interest.
steps: Confirm the usable supply window
Locate original calendars or buyer-declared cycle requirements
Check that the named buyer is procuring in this cycle
Agree a timed stock or capacity allocation
proof: Current cycle, actual requirement, quantity and delivery before the buyer's deadline
metric: Buyer-confirmed orders within the independently checked buying window

name: Rights-based asset licensing
job: Find a commercial brief whose usage rights and technical needs fit a licensed asset.
steps: Confirm seller ownership and permitted rights
Locate authorized publishing or production briefs
Check usage, territory, formats and exclusivity
Prepare a rights-specific reviewed licence offer
proof: Rights chain, real authorized brief, usage scope and commercial agreement
metric: Executed appropriate licences for verified briefs

name: Lawful circular feedstock
job: Find a permitted reuse process that can accept the precise waste, surplus or reusable component.
steps: Characterize condition, provenance and permitted use
Locate qualified processors and published intake specifications
Verify current intake acceptance and safe handling
Arrange an approved inspected transfer
proof: Lawful provenance, material identification, permitted destination and accepted intake
metric: Accepted lawful recovery batches with verified weights and custody

name: Consented local access
job: Find an accessible local service or delivery arrangement for an explicitly stated need.
steps: Confirm actual service or delivery area
Use permitted business locations and voluntary local requests
Resolve receiving point, language and buyer's explicit interest
Obtain a clear authorized local booking or collection
proof: Opt-in need, real service area, receiving arrangement and permitted contact
metric: Consented local opportunities reaching a verified service or delivery arrangement

name: Trade-ready cross-border supply
job: Find a legitimate private buyer whose order and landed requirements fit the seller's export capability.
steps: Confirm source, destination and seller's real trade capability
Locate authorized importer or buying-agent briefs
Check current trade requirements, landed costs and receiving terms
Propose a documented compliant sample or shipment
proof: Buyer mandate, current trade eligibility, quality documents and agreed delivered economics
metric: Verified eligible import orders or approved samples, with trade failures retained

name: Authorized specialist introduction
job: Use an approved intermediary to connect a concrete need with a capable seller.
steps: Confirm seller capability and intermediary role
Find a published relevant referral or inspection pathway
Obtain explicit permission for the specific introduction
Track the recipient's actual response without assuming acceptance
proof: Intermediary mandate, actual recipient need, introduction consent and response
metric: Consented introductions producing independently confirmed relevant responses

name: Buyer-approved bounded pilot
job: Turn an uncertain fit into a small approved experiment with a defined commercial decision.
steps: State a falsifiable buyer problem and feasible seller promise
Locate explicit pilot briefs or authorized business owners
Agree scope, budget, data rights and acceptance criteria
Run only after approval and record the buyer's decision
proof: Authorized problem, approved scope and spend, baseline and objective acceptance test
metric: Pilots accepted by real buyers against predeclared criteria, including failed pilots

name: Viable lot and delivered economics
job: Match stock, quantities and total delivery cost to a buyer whose acceptable deal remains economical.
steps: Confirm units, condition, minimum lot and actual pricing basis
Locate buyers or intermediaries with compatible order economics
Compare like-for-like total delivered terms
Obtain a reviewed sample, inspection or lot commitment
proof: Comparable units, minimum lot, delivered price, accepted condition and buyer commitment
metric: Economically viable accepted lots; quotations and sales reported separately
